symbolic_results: Every oracle-free public effective probabilistic program with public effective stochastic primitives and almost-sure termination has an exact external sampler: a universal interpreter run on an independent copy of the same public random source.

The terminal-presentation support of fair-bit probabilistic programs is computably enumerable by finite-prefix enumeration; effective finitely-branching or c.e.-branching nondeterministic support is enumerable by dovetailing.
Any public deterministic terminal materialization/readout preserves the externalized output law, so branch opacity does not create a distributionally new support/factor capability.

A nonexternalizable but executable survivor must import an operational resource outside the public effective specification, such as oracle access, secret state/implementation, hidden-factor-correlated state, or an asymmetric model privilege.
